desk_reject_comments.value:
Desk rejected because of LLM usage not disclosed as required by ICLR 2026 policy.

Evidence for LLM usage includes hallucinated references:
-Shu Guo, Quan Wang, Lihong Wang, and Bin Wang. Learning to represent knowledge graphs with
gaussian embedding. In NeurIPS, 2020.

-> this paper doesn't exist. There is a different paper with some of those authors, and a paper with that title published at a different conference by different authors

YooJung Choi, Antonio Vergari, Guy Van den Broeck, and Adnan Darwiche. Probabilistic circuits:
A unifying framework for tractable probabilistic models. arXiv preprint arXiv:2005.02479, 2020.

-> this paper does not have Adnan Darwiche as an author, and it is not posted on arxiv. The arxiv preprint number is hallucinated, and corresponds to a paper titled "Online Bitrate Selection for Viewport Adaptive 360-Degree Video Streaming"

... Liu. Diagnosing the z-paradox in distance-based knowledge graph embeddings. In EMNLP, 2024.
Please fill in final metadata.

-> this paper doesn't exist and is cited several times.  "Please fill in final metadata." is likely an LLM artifact

Davide Loconte, Xingyu Lin, Rasmus Korrel, Claudia d’Amato, and Antonio Vergari. How to turn
your knowledge graph embeddings into generative models. In NeurIPS, 2023.

-> There is a paper by that title, but it is not written by Xingyu Lin, Rasmus Korrel, Claudia d’Amato which appear to be entirely hallucinated author names. The paper is cited for the baseline algorithm ExpressiveE in Table 1, but that paper by the cited title is not about ExpressiveE at all.

Liangming Pan, Wanjun Ding, Yizhou Sun, and Jie Zhou. The blessing of structural noise: Can
adversarial perturbations improve kge generalization? In NeurIPS, 2023.

-> this paper doesn't exist.
